description.sr: Spisak studenata na poseti udruženju dostavio je voditelj predmeta 12.10.2026. uz materijal posete; zapažanja o korišćenju radova upisana su u registar radova.
description.en: The list of students on the association visit was supplied by the course lead on 12 October 2026 with the visit material; observations about the use of the works are recorded in the work register.

summary.sr: Poseta udruženju održana je u petak 09.10.2026, istog dana kad je održan drugi čas. Studenti su doneli prototipove započete na prvom času; korisnici udruženja su ih probali na stolu, bez usmeravanja. Temeljna analiza interakcije objavljena je na strani Poseta udruženju; zapažanja uz pojedinačne radove stoje u registru radova.
summary.en: The association visit took place on Friday, 9 October 2026, the same day as the second class. Students brought the prototypes begun in the first class; the association’s users tried them at the table, without prompting. A full analysis of the interaction is published on the Visit page; observations for individual works stand in the work register.
